Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, proteinuria, hematuria, nitrites, and bacteriuria, with >100,000 CFU/mL Enterococcus faecalis cultured, indicating a urinary tract infection. Low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. No casts detected. Findings are consistent with an active UTI; clinical correlation and appropriate antimicrobial therapy are recommended.
